Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent ORM / Social Media Manager to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new ORM / Social Media Manager , you will be the person who makes Contabo's shift from an affordable VPS provider to a reliable, AI ready, developer friendly infrastructure brand real, in the exact communities where developers, DevOps engineers, and AI practitioners actually talk. You build that credibility from the ground up, combining daily community intelligence with real commercial content production.

Every day, you monitor selected online platforms like Reddit or Discord, triaging brand mentions for further action. You also engage proactively wherever technical conversations happen, from tutorials and GPU workload guides to infrastructure tips and genuine participation in technical discussions, always credibility first and aligned with our tone of voice.

Alongside that, you plan and produce our commercial and marketing content, including product launch announcements, promotional posts, competitor positioning, Contabo Black go-to-market content, event content, and repurposed community threads, all planned in a rolling content calendar, in collaboration with other functions in Marketing. You also write and maintain community intervention playbooks, so the whole team knows how to respond before a situation escalates.

On top of the day to day, you get to build our internal advocacy programme from scratch: you identify technically fluent colleagues across Product and Engineering, bring them on board with clear guidelines, and keep them engaged over time, working toward a team of active online and offline advocates.

You report directly to our Head of Creative Marketing, and the monthly picture you build of sentiment, Share of Voice, and platform activity feeds straight into product and marketing decisions, with real visibility all the way up to our CMO. At its core, this role lives at the intersection of protecting our reputation and driving commercial content forward: someone who speaks the language of developers, but thinks like a marketer.

What convinces us Your personality, paired with:
• 5 to 7 years of experience in community management, ORM, social media, or content marketing, ideally with some background in producing commercial or marketing content
• Hands-on experience with ORM or social listening platforms (Brandwatch, Mention, Sprinklr, Peec.ai, or similar), and confidence running sentiment analysis and Share of Voice reporting
• Strong social media content creation skills across platform native formats, from Reddit and Discord to LinkedIn and X, paired with real commercial and marketing content production experience such as product marketing copy, promotional posts, and competitor positioning
• Genuine community management and engagement experience with a developer or tech focused audience, and the analytical ability to turn what you see there into decisions
• Strong communication and conflict handling skills, clear goal and result orientation, and the ability to build and grow a network without formal authority
• A proactive, ownership driven mindset: you handle pressure well, stay customer oriented, and hold yourself to a high-performance bar
• An authentic community voice who shows up as a real person rather than a brand account, thinks commercially about when community presence drives business outcomes, and stays composed under public criticism without escalating situations
• AI fluency beyond basic prompting skills

Should have:
• Experience coordinating events or conferences, and managing an ORM agency or similar external vendor relationship
• Strong strategic thinking, genuine team spirit, and openness to change as the role and priorities evolve
• A natural sense of ownership that extends beyond your core tasks
• Real curiosity about the cloud, hosting, and developer ecosystem, and a habit of following those communities on your own
• Industry experience in cloud infrastructure, hosting, SaaS, or developer tools, ideally with a B2B tech marketing background
• Great Reddit karma

Nice to have:
• Spanish or Portuguese for LATAM coverage, and German language skills, are a plus alongside fluent English (C1+)
• ORM or social listening platform certifications, Google Analytics, or AI, SEO, and GAIO monitoring credentials
• A degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field, though equivalent practical experience with a solid technical understanding works just as well

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Resident Quality Engineer (f/m/d), you will spend your day working closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product quality, production stability, and delivery performance. A significant portion of your role involves being on-site at supplier locations, leading quality escalations, supporting production recovery, and driving sustainable process improvements. You will analyze manufacturing challenges, coordinate corrective actions, conduct audits, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams to strengthen process capability and customer satisfaction. With approximately 25–30% travel, you will play a critical role in maintaining quality excellence across the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Deployment to supplier sites as a dedicated quality escalation expert to stabilize production following critical quality, technical, or delivery issues
* Leadership of immediate containment activities to prevent defect escapes, protect customers, and maintain operational continuity
* Development and management of supplier recovery plans including action tracking, milestone management, accountability, and executive reporting
* Execution of root cause analyses, manufacturing process reviews, and quality audits to identify risks, process gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Definition, implementation, validation, and sustainability tracking of corrective and preventive actions to address both short-term and systemic issues
* Collaboration with supplier engineering, quality, and operations teams to improve process capability, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term performance

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive experience in quality management, manufacturing environments, supplier quality, and production process improvement
* Strong expertise in root cause analysis, problem-solving methodologies, Kaizen, supplier recovery activities, and critical manufacturing process assessments
* Proven ability to identify technical failure mechanisms, implement sustainable process improvements, and ensure long-term effectiveness of corrective actions
* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments, ideally with turbine hot gas components or other complex manufacturing technologies
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, combined with fluency in German and English and willingness to travel approximately 25–30% to supplier locations worldwide

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Contribute to the development of new microstructured materials, microfluidic chips, and advanced LoC technologies.

Develop novel microfluidics-based methodologies and provide SOPs to ensure reliable and reproducible use.
Propose and discuss organizational and infrastructure improvements with the MPZPM board, focusing on optimized workflows, state-of-the-art technologies, and strategic upgrades aligned with the institute’s priorities.

Experience in managing laboratories, particularly cleanrooms, including staff supervision and operation of microfabrication workflows.
Strong organizational, leadership, and project-management skills, with a track record of building or expanding scientific infrastructure.
Expertise in developing microfluidic technologies.
Capability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines. English is the primary working language; knowledge of German is advantageous.
Experience in technology transfer, device development, or industry collaboration is a plus.

Ideal Technical Competencies (some of the following):

Microfabrication & Lithography: photolithography, soft lithography, micropatterning of rigid and soft materials, biomolecule patterning via microcontact printing or LIMA photopatterning.
Microfluidics & Lab-on-a-Chip Systems: design, production, and integration of microfluidic chips with fluidic, optical and electronic components.
Soft Material Microstructuring: hydrogels, droplet microfluidics, and other soft materials relevant to biomedical applications.

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
